debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technical structure (9/21 golden cross, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (17/100) creates contrarian swing entry opportunity near support at 57.56.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak trend confirmation (ADX 14.61, no money flow, no AO confirmation), zero fundamental support, macro crisis (VIX 397.6, FOMC today, rising dollar), and price below 50/200 EMAs make this a high-risk fade into weakness rather than a conviction entry.
